description: Defines the RoomImpl class implementing the IRoom interface for managing chat room interactions, including user join/leave notifications, message sending, and callback management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: RoomImpl
classes.description: Implements the IRoom interface, managing room interactions, user callbacks, and message notifications within the plugin.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the room via the room administrator.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Registers or unregisters a callback for user events and notifies the callback of current room users.

methods.name: UserJoined
methods.description: Handles notification that a user has joined the room.

methods.name: UserLeft
methods.description: Handles notification that a user has left the room.

methods.name: MessageReceived
methods.description: Forwards received messages to the message sink.

methods.name: UserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with this room instance.

methods.name: RoomId
methods.description: Returns the room ID associated with this room instance.
